Why: Introduces MinSight, our browser-based platform for fitting and interpreting Mössbauer spectra. It makes the technique easier to use by comparing users' spectra with a library of published data.
Shows how microorganisms create, alter and dissolve magnetic iron minerals, challenging the long-held view that the magnetic record in rocks forms through inorganic processes alone.

A review of new insights into how iron cycles through the environment, including the finding that its oxidation and reduction often happen together, and what this means for greenhouse gases, nutrients and contaminants.

Showed that magnetite can act like a rechargeable battery for bacteria, storing and releasing electrons as iron-reducing and iron-oxidising bacteria take turns. It is the basis of our biogeobatteries research.
